values.hanji: 拍開了後，齒盤會記錄各詞揀過幾擺，定定揀 ê 詞會排較頭前。
values.tailo: phah-khui liáu-āu, khí-puânn ē kì-lio̍k kok ê sû kíng kuè kuí-pái, tiānn-tiānn kíng ê sû ē pâi khah thâu-tsîng.

values.en: When on, the keyboard records how often you select each word. Frequently selected words move toward the front of the candidate list.
values.ja: オンにすると、各単語を選んだ回数を記録します。よく選ぶ単語は候補リストの前方に移動します。

values.hanji: 拍開了後，齒盤會記錄詞佮詞 ê 前後關係，用來改善下一詞建議。
values.tailo: phah-khui liáu-āu, khí-puânn ē kì-lio̍k sû kah sû ê tsiân-āu kuan-hē, iōng lâi kái-siān ē tsi̍t ê sû kiàn-gī.

values.ja: オンにすると、単語の前後関係を記録し、次の単語の候補に利用します。

frequencyPrivacyWarning.comment: Privacy warning about sharing word-frequency data for research.

values.hanji: 詞頻紀錄可能會反映你揀過 ê 詞。匯出抑是分享進前，請先檢查敏感內容。關閉紀錄了後，齒盤袂閣學習你的候選詞排序。
values.tailo: sû pîn kì-lio̍k khó-lîng ē huán-ìng lí kíng kuè ê sû. huē-tshut ah-sī hun-hióng tsìn-tsîng, tshiánn sian kiám-tsa bín-kám luē-iông. kuainn--khí-lâi liáu-āu, khí-puânn buē koh ha̍k-si̍p lí ê hāu-suán sû pâi-sī.
values.poj: sû pîn kì-lio̍k khó-lêng ē hoán-èng lí kéng kòe ê sû. hōe-chhut ah-sī hun-hióng chìn-chêng, chhiáⁿ sian kiám-cha bín-kám lōe-iông. koaiⁿ--khí-lâi liáu-āu, khí-pôaⁿ bōe koh ha̍k-si̍p lí ê hāu-soán sû pâi-sī.
values.en: Frequency records may reflect words you have selected. Check for sensitive content before exporting or sharing them. When recording is off, the keyboard stops learning your candidate ranking.
values.ja: 単語頻度の記録には、選んだ単語が反映される場合があります。エクスポートや共有の前に、機密情報が含まれていないか確認してください。記録をオフにすると、候補の並び順を学習しなくなります。

values.ja: すべての単語頻度の記録を削除

associationPrivacyWarning.comment: Privacy warning about sharing word-association data for research.

values.hanji: 詞關聯紀錄可能會反映你拍過 ê 詞組。匯出抑是分享進前，請先檢查敏感內容。關閉紀錄了後，齒盤袂閣學習你的下一詞使用習慣。
values.tailo: sû kuan-liân kì-lio̍k khó-lîng ē huán-ìng lí phah kuè ê sû-tsoo. huē-tshut ah-sī hun-hióng tsìn-tsîng, tshiánn sian kiám-tsa bín-kám luē-iông. kuainn--khí-lâi liáu-āu, khí-puânn buē koh ha̍k-si̍p lí ê ē tsi̍t ê sû sú-iōng si̍p-kuàn.
values.poj: sû koan-liân kì-lio̍k khó-lêng ē hoán-èng lí phah kòe ê sû-cho͘. hōe-chhut ah-sī hun-hióng chìn-chêng, chhiáⁿ sian kiám-cha bín-kám lōe-iông. koaiⁿ--khí-lâi liáu-āu, khí-pôaⁿ bōe koh ha̍k-si̍p lí ê ē chi̍t ê sû sú-iōng si̍p-koàn.
values.en: Association records may reflect phrases you have typed. Check for sensitive content before exporting or sharing them. When recording is off, the keyboard stops learning your next-word habits.
values.ja: 単語連携の記録には、入力した語句が反映される場合があります。エクスポートや共有の前に、機密情報が含まれていないか確認してください。記録をオフにすると、次の単語の使い方を学習しなくなります。

backupPrivacyWarning.comment: Privacy note that backup files contain all usage records and are cross-platform.

values.hanji: 備份檔案包含自訂詞、詞頻佮詞關聯紀錄，會當佇 iOS 佮 Android 匯入。檔案可能包含私人內容，請妥當保管。
values.tailo: pī-hūn tòng-àn pau-hâm tsū-tīng-sû, sû pîn kah sû kuan-liân kì-lio̍k, ē-tàng tī iOS kah Android huē-ji̍p. tòng-àn khó-lîng pau-hâm su-jîn luē-iông, tshiánn thò-tòng pó-kuán.
values.poj: pī-hūn tòng-àn pau-hâm chū-tēng-sû, sû pîn kah sû koan-liân kì-lio̍k, ē-tàng tī iOS kah Android hōe-ji̍p. tòng-àn khó-lêng pau-hâm su-jîn lōe-iông, chhiáⁿ thò-tòng pó-koán.
values.en: A backup contains your custom words, frequency records, and association records. You can import it on iOS or Android. Store the file securely because it may contain private content.
values.ja: バックアップには、カスタム単語、単語頻度、単語連携の記録が含まれます。iOS と Android のどちらでもインポートできます。個人的な内容が含まれる場合があるため、安全に保管してください。

moeDescription.comment: MOE Sutian dictionary — long description shown under its toggle in dictionary settings.

values.hanji: 台語、華語攏會當揣，詞目佮例句有發音通聽，學習較利便。閣有分類、部首筆劃索引佮附錄。
values.tailo: Tâi-gí, huâ-gí lóng ē-tàng tshuē, sû-ba̍k kah lē-kù ū huat-im thang thiann, ha̍k-si̍p khah lī-piān. Koh ū hun-luī, pōo-siú pit-ue̍h sik-ín kah hù-lio̍k.
values.poj: Tâi-gí, hôa-gí lóng ē-tàng chhōe, sû-ba̍k kah lē-kù ū hoat-im thang thiaⁿ, ha̍k-si̍p khah lī-piān. Koh ū hun-lūi, pō͘-siú pit-oe̍h sek-ín kah hù-lio̍k.
values.en: Search Taiwanese Taigi and Mandarin, with audio for headwords and example sentences for easy learning. Includes category and radical-stroke indexes plus appendices.
values.ja: 台湾語と中国語で検索でき、見出し語と例文の発音を聞いて学習できます。分類索引・部首画数索引・付録付き。

newwordDescription.comment: Taigi TV new-words dictionary — toggle description in dictionary settings.

values.hanji: 台語台招專家學者，定期開會，討論新詞愛按怎用台語講較好，建立詞庫予逐家查、予逐家用。
values.tailo: Tâi-gí-tâi tsio tsuan-ka ha̍k-tsiá, tīng-kî khui-huē, thó-lūn sin-sû ài àn-tsuánn iōng tâi-gí kóng khah hó, kiàn-li̍p sû-khòo hōo ta̍k-ke tsa, hōo ta̍k-ke iōng.
values.poj: Tâi-gí-tâi chio choan-ka ha̍k-chiá, tēng-kî khui-hōe, thó-lūn sin-sû ài àn-chóaⁿ iōng tâi-gí kóng khah hó, kiàn-li̍p sû-khò͘ hō͘ ta̍k-ke cha, hō͘ ta̍k-ke iōng.
values.en: Taigi TV invites experts and scholars to meet regularly, settle fitting Taigi terms for emerging words, and build a public lookup glossary.
values.ja: 台語テレビ局が専門家・学者を招き、定期的に会議を開いて新語の適切な台湾語表現を検討し、一般向けの検索辞書を構築しています。

sttiDescription.comment: MOE academic-terminology (STTI) dictionary — toggle description in dictionary settings.

values.hanji: 對 106 年開始，共語文、數學、社會、自然科學、藝術、綜合活動、科技、健康佮體育這 8 大領域 ê 學科術語編做台語。
values.tailo: Tuì 106 nî khai-sí, kā gí-bûn, sòo-ha̍k, siā-huē, tsū-jiân kho-ha̍k, gē-su̍t, tsong-ha̍p ua̍h-tōng, kho-ki, kiān-khong kah thé-io̍k tsit 8 tāi líng-i̍k ê ha̍k-kho su̍t-gí pian-tsò tâi-gí.
values.poj: Tuì 106 nî khai-sí, kā gí-bûn, sò͘-ha̍k, siā-hōe, chū-jiân kho-ha̍k, gē-su̍t, chong-ha̍p oa̍h-tōng, kho-ki, kiān-khong kah thé-io̍k chit 8 tāi léng-e̍k ê ha̍k-kho su̍t-gí pian-chò tâi-gí.
values.en: Since 2017, the project has translated academic terminology from eight fields into Taigi: language arts, mathematics, social studies, natural science, arts, integrative activities, technology, and health and physical education.
values.ja: 2017年から、国語・数学・社会・自然科学・芸術・総合的活動・科学技術・保健体育の8領域の学科用語を台湾語に翻訳しています。

kunggeDescription.comment: Craft-terms (Kungge) dictionary — toggle description in dictionary settings.

values.hanji: 收規一千兩百組重要 ê 台語工藝詞，包括陶瓷、木藝、金工、竹藤、纖維、玻璃、漆藝、石藝、皮革、紙藝這 11 項工藝類別。
values.tailo: Siu kui it-tshian nn̄g-pah tsoo tiōng-iàu ê tâi-gí kang-gē sû, pau-kuat tô-tsû, bo̍k-gē, kim-kang, tik-tîn, siam-uî, po-lê, tshat-gē, tsio̍h-gē, phuê-kik, tsuá-gē tsit 11 hāng kang-gē luī-pia̍t.
values.poj: Siu kui it-chhian nn̄g-pah cho͘ tiōng-iàu ê tâi-gí kang-gē sû, pau-koat tô-chû, bo̍k-gē, kim-kang, tek-tîn, siam-ûi, po-lê, chhat-gē, chio̍h-gē, phôe-kek, chóa-gē chit 11 hāng kang-gē lūi-pia̍t.
values.en: Over 1,200 key Taigi craft terms covering eleven categories such as ceramics, woodcraft, metalwork, bamboo and rattan, fiber, glass, lacquer, stonework, leather, and paper craft.
values.ja: 陶磁・木工・金工・竹藤・繊維・ガラス・漆芸・石工・皮革・紙工など11分野にわたる、1,200組を超える台湾語の工芸用語を収録。

lkkDescription.comment: Lí Kang-Khioh Foundation Han-Roman dictionary — toggle description in dictionary settings.

values.en: Suggested Han-Roman mixed-script characters from the Lí Kang-Khioh Taigi Culture and Education Foundation.

devDescription.comment: Developer supplement dictionary — toggle description in dictionary settings.

values.hanji: 補充政府機關、常見人名、行政區、數字、時間、日期佮其他教典較少收錄 ê 詞。
values.tailo: póo-tshiong tsìng-hú ki-kuan, siông-kiàn jîn-miâ, hîng-tsìng-khu, sòo-jī, sî-kan, ji̍t-kî kah kî-thann kàu-tián khah tsió siu-lio̍k ê sû.
values.poj: pó͘-chhiong chèng-hú ki-koan, siông-kiàn jîn-miâ, hêng-chèng-khu, sò͘-jī, sî-kan, ji̍t-kî kah kî-thaⁿ kàu-tián khah chió siu-lio̍k ê sû.
values.en: Adds government agencies, common names, administrative divisions, dates, times, numbers, and other words with limited coverage in the MOE Dictionary.
values.ja: 政府機関、一般的な人名、行政区、日付、時刻、数字など、教育部辞典で収録の少ない語を補います。

values.hanji: 一个群眾編輯 ê 開放台語辭典
values.tailo: Tsi̍t-ê kûn-tsiòng pian-tsi̍p ê khai-hòng tâi-gí sû-tián
values.poj: Chi̍t-ê kûn-chiòng pian-chi̍p ê khai-hòng tâi-gí sû-tián
values.ja: みんなで編集するオープンな台湾語辞典。

values.hanji: 日本時代小川尚義編纂 ê 台語辭典。
values.tailo: Ji̍t-pún sî-tāi Siáu-tshuan Siōng-gī pian-tshuàn ê tâi-gí sû-tián.
values.poj: Ji̍t-pún sî-tāi Siáu-chhoan Siōng-gī pian-chhoàn ê tâi-gí sû-tián.
values.en: A Taigi dictionary compiled by Ogawa Naoyoshi during the Japanese era.
values.ja: 日本統治時代に小川尚義が編纂した台湾語辞典。
